$comment: The behavioural coverage inventory: every user-facing schema path and closed branch of the audited schemas plus TASK-207, the scenarios that exercise it, what correct use is, and who owns the evidence. author-run: a model run proves it (graded by the blinded grader against source); harness-check: the deterministic outcome checks prove it from the saved board; grader: only the grader can judge it; runtime-owner: an existing fast test owns it and no model run is asked to. An entry with no scenarios is uncovered by model runs and says so.
